svg.text: Z07: 16 desks, 8 other seats, storage 48 lin ft / 207 cu ft, free floor 1005 sft | Z06: 13 desks, storage 10 lin ft / 58 cu ft, free floor 1045 sft

Green tint: floor with at least 48 in (1220 mm) clear width. Blue: proposed glazed screens. Dashed blue: ceiling AC positions (unchanged). Black squares: steel columns (positions PHOTO-EST). Plan inches, north up.
